# RationalPrince — Institutional Macro Research & Investor Desk Tools

> RationalPrince publishes institutional-style research on energy, maritime chokepoints such as the Strait of Hormuz, and sovereign capital, plus desk tools for self-directed investors: AI research systems, portfolio trackers, planners and Notion dashboards. Products are sold outright through Gumroad and delivered instantly. Educational material only; not investment advice.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://rationalprince.com/): Store, flagship product, how purchasing works, and the Strait of Hormuz desk reference
- [Home (Markdown)](https://rationalprince.com/index.md): Plain Markdown version of the homepage for agents
- [Strait of Hormuz desk reference](https://rationalprince.com/#hormuz): Q&A on status, control, width, depth, transit counts and oil-price effects
- [About](https://rationalprince.com/about): Who RationalPrince is and how the research is produced
- [Contact](https://rationalprince.com/contact): How to reach RationalPrince
- [Privacy](https://rationalprince.com/privacy): What data the site and its checkout partners collect

## Research (free explainers)

- [Research hub](https://rationalprince.com/research/): All free research from the desk
- [Brent vs WTI: What Physical Flows and Geopolitics Reveal About the Spread](https://rationalprince.com/research/brent-vs-wti-spread/): Why Brent trades above WTI, what widens the Brent–WTI spread (Cushing, pipelines, exports, OPEC+, Hormuz risk) and how institutional desks trade it.
- [Contango vs Backwardation: What the Oil Futures Curve Tells You](https://rationalprince.com/research/contango-vs-backwardation-oil/): Contango and backwardation explained for oil: cost of carry, convenience yield, calendar spreads, roll yield, the 2020 negative WTI price, and a desk checklist.
- [Crack Spread Explained: How Refining Margins Signal Oil Demand](https://rationalprince.com/research/crack-spread-explained/): What the oil crack spread is, how to calculate the 3-2-1 crack with a worked example, gasoline vs diesel cracks, what moves refining margins and why investors watch it.
- [What Is a Sovereign Wealth Fund? How State Capital Moves Markets](https://rationalprince.com/research/sovereign-wealth-funds-explained/): Sovereign wealth funds explained: how they are funded, the five types, the biggest funds (Norway, PIF, ADIA, KIA, QIA, CIC, GIC), and why oil prices move state capital.
